# Calculator.net

> > A comprehensive suite of free online calculators for financial planning, fitness tracking, and scientific computations.

Calculator.net offers specialized tools across multiple domains including mortgage and loan calculators, retirement planning, investment analysis, and health metrics. The platform serves users seeking quick financial calculations with detailed breakdowns, amortization schedules, and tax considerations.

## Key Topics

- Mortgage Calculator
- Loan Calculator
- Compound Interest
- Retirement Planning
- Amortization Schedule
- APR/APY
- 401K and Roth IRA
- Social Security
- Investment Returns
- Inflation Calculator
- BMI and Body Composition
- Monthly Payment
- Financial Planning
- Tax Calculation
- Auto Loan

## Financial Calculators

- [Financial Calculators](https://www.calculator.net/financial-calculator.html): Comprehensive collection of financial calculators for mortgages, loans, investments, retirement.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/mortgage-calculator.html): Free mortgage calculator with payment, amortization schedule, taxes, PMI, HOA options.
- [Loan Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/loan-calculator.html): Loan calculator for amortized loans, deferred payments, bonds with APR/APY calculation.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/auto-loan-calculator.html): Auto loan calculator for monthly payments, sales tax, fees, trade-in value accounting.
- [Amortization Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/amortization-calculator.html): Amortization calculator showing payment schedules, graphs, and loan breakdowns.

## Interest & Investment Calculators

- [Interest Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/interest-calculator.html): Compound interest calculator for fixed investments and periodic contributions.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/compound-interest-calculator.html): Compound interest calculator comparing rates and compounding periods.
- [Interest Rate Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/interest-rate-calculator.html): Interest rate calculator for amortized loans with fixed monthly payments.
- [Investment Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/investment-calculator.html): Investment calculator evaluating returns, contributions, and growth scenarios.
- [Finance Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/finance-calculator.html): Finance calculator for time-value-of-money: FV, PV, interest rate, PMT calculations.

## Retirement & Tax Planning

- [Retirement Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/retirement-calculator.html): Retirement planning calculator with Social Security, 401K, Roth IRA, inflation factors.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/tax-calculator.html): Federal income tax calculator for salary earners and self-employed contractors.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/inflation-calculator.html): Inflation calculator using U.S. CPI data with historical trends and purchasing power.

## Payment & Salary Calculators

- [Payment Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/payment-calculator.html): Payment calculator for monthly amounts and payoff periods with fixed terms.
- [Salary Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/salary-calculator.html): Salary converter between hourly, biweekly, monthly, and annual with adjustments.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/sales-tax-calculator.html): Sales tax calculator with rates by U.S. state and VAT/GST support.

## Fitness & Health Calculators

- [Fitness and Health Calculators](https://www.calculator.net/fitness-and-health-calculator.html): Fitness and health calculator hub: BMI, body fat, calorie, pregnancy calculators.
- [BMI Calculator](https://www.calculator.net/bmi-calculator.html): BMI calculator for adults and children using WHO and CDC standards.
